subject: The truth about what I set aside for 30-day users only
preview_text: This expires tomorrow. I wasn't going to send this, but you've been here since the beginning.
body_paragraphs: I made a mistake when I built Smart Notes. I built something so powerful, I was scared to release it to everyone. So I locked it away. For 30 days, I've been watching how people use the app. And you're one of the few who actually gets it.

Here's the confession: I set aside 50 lifetime premium slots for the first 30-day users. Not a discount. Not a trial. Lifetime access at the launch price, forever. It expires tomorrow at midnight. This isn't marketing. This is me saying thank you to the people who saw the vision before anyone else.

When you upgrade, every feature unlocks. The AI doesn't just transcribe—it learns how you think. It starts predicting what matters to you in meetings. The search becomes frighteningly accurate. You'll stop taking notes completely and just listen. That's the secret weapon.

Tap below. Use the VIP code 30DAYFOUNDER. It works until tomorrow night. Then it's gone forever. This is the last email I'll send you. Make it count. P.S. The first 10 people who upgrade get a 30-minute call with me to build your perfect workflow. No charge. Just between us.
P.P.S. Seriously. Tomorrow this disappears. The 50 slots are half gone already.
